acceptance_signals: The human-admitted task and create-only task-start baseline exist before any real probe, root allocation, evidence write, staging, action, or build.
Every pre-existing changed path is classified; existing baseline files beneath the included baseline prefix are preservation-only and every excluded predecessor path remains byte-identical.

Read-only preflight verifies the manifest identities, one compatible fixed launcher, one exact retained backend wheel, unchanged readiness/caller/driver/root contracts, and zero task-owned short roots before invocation.
Exactly one run_ready_artifact_replay call receives one private InvocationTransportRequest plus the unchanged driver arguments and one injected real action.
The caller performs exactly one real fixed readiness probe and accepts only its fresh normalized PASS before exactly one driver invocation.

The injected action stages exactly the manifest-selected regular inputs, invokes one offline no-index no-dependency no-build-isolation no-cache wheel build, validates managed payload parity, and returns one privacy-bounded evidence document.
The unchanged driver exclusively writes and fsyncs the new evidence, creates its receipt, calls evidence-gated cleanup, and reports exact-root absence.
Success reports readiness_attempts=1, driver_attempts=1, action_attempts=1, cleanup_removed=true, exact nested PASS reports, denied authority, and a final zero-root observation.

Any first deviation stops without retry, repair, alternate backend, second caller/probe/driver/action/build, manual cleanup, or a false success claim; any private recovery root remains untouched pending separate human-controlled recovery.

Only the admitted task, new baseline, new evidence, STATUS, and dated log may change; checker, caller, driver, manifest, tests, prior records, prior evidence, contracts, and configuration remain byte-identical.
Focused and full supported tests plus manifest, task, repository, scope, JSON, privacy, zero-root, whitespace, and diff checks pass.

No dependency installation, network request, public CLI, scheduler, external Agent, model, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, retry, repair, or broader end-to-end journey occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-fd9d6f666d704b62924bf13057c62974 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Perform exactly one bounded real offline wheel-build replay through the repository-internal run_ready_artifact_replay caller. Capture a create-only task-start baseline and pass read-only preflight before the call. The caller must execute one fresh real readiness probe before exactly one unchanged driver invocation; the injected action stages the current manifest-selected inputs, performs one offline no-index no-dependency no-build-isolation no-cache wheel build, validates payload parity, and returns one sanitized evidence document for driver-owned durable write and evidence-gated cleanup. Stop at the first deviation without retry, repair, alternate backend, manual cleanup, implementation changes, or a second replay.

items: One real replay may fail after allocating a short root; the wrapper must preserve the private recovery handle and no cleanup outside the validated evidence gate is authorized.
The readiness result is point-in-time and cannot eliminate launcher, backend, or root replacement races after observation.
The checker bounds output only after process capture, so a misbehaving launcher remains a known memory-risk gap.
A foreground one-off invocation could accidentally bypass the wrapper; call structure and normalized report must prove the wrapper owned readiness-before-driver ordering.
The dirty worktree contains five completed predecessor slices; broad baseline-prefix inclusion grants no authority to alter prior baseline files.

Evidence could leak host paths, process output, source content, credentials, or action representations; persisted output is restricted to normalized counts, digests, booleans, bounded reason codes, and denied authority.
